text: So sorry to message this late, I really hope I'm not wasting anyone's time. I'm a childminder and I've got an 8 year old boy staying over tonight, his temp is 39.9. About ten minutes ago he had a fit, his whole body went stiff and then shaking and his eyes rolled up, it's never happened to him before, his mum's confirmed that. He's breathing normally now, I've been watching his chest the whole time. I also noticed little dark red pinprick dots on his tummy and some purplish blotches like bruises and when I pressed a glass on them they didn't go away at all. I'm sorry, I just don't know if I'm overreacting.
